object_description: three-part compact L-shaped volume stepped into the slope
design_condition: Placed at the lower edge of the site, the volume follows the rising terrain and interweaves with the existing complex, forest, sports fields, and sloping outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The finely structured, compact volume forms a successful and harmonious ensemble with the existing school complex.

position.rationale: Three stepped wings and the L-shaped arrangement are clearly visible in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The school is cleverly integrated into the rising terrain, with access points at all levels.

position.rationale: Stepped massing visibly follows the slope, with access implied at multiple levels.

positive.statement: The covered outdoor hall becomes a gathering center with good outdoor access to shared uses.

position.rationale: Central overlap between the stepped wings is the clearest plausible covered gathering zone.

positive.statement: The airy interpenetration of inside and outside continues through the upper-floor decks and protective balconies.

position.rationale: Repeated projecting upper-level edges are visible around the elevated stepped volume.

positive.statement: The clusters can be flexibly subdivided and arranged according to different educational concepts.

position.rationale: Interior clusters are not distinguishable; distributed across the upper connected wings.

positive.statement: The sports facilities are accessible from the lower level and easy for non-school users to find.

position.rationale: Lower-level sports access is anchored to the lower stepped portion of the complex.

positive.statement: The project shows coherence between its expression, diverse outdoor areas, and generous internal flexibility.

position.rationale: Stepped expression and multiple mass gaps are consistently visible across plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The artificial ventilation concept is incomprehensible under these optimal conditions.

position.rationale: Ventilation equipment is unrepresented; anchor to occupied upper-level envelope.

negative.statement: The external connecting staircases could be left open.

position.rationale: Staircases are not separately resolved; approximate the central level connector between wings.

negative.statement: The new building should be more open and permeable, with stronger interaction between levels and the two schools.

position.target: new building and two schools interaction
position.rationale: Inter-building permeability is assessed across the connected stepped mass, not a distinct visible element.

negative.statement: The separate gymnasium requires considerable excavation and undermines the otherwise sensitive handling of the situation.

position.rationale: Gymnasium is not identifiable; approximate a detached lower-edge volume.

negative.statement: Large basement areas, redundant accesses, and oversized areas cause the project to overshoot the cost target by far.

position.target: large basement areas and redundant accesses
position.rationale: Basements and internal accesses are absent; anchor near the extensive lower building footprint.
